facts.text: Hear me out, Dale. We order the big pizza, split it three ways, and nobody mentions work tonight.
facts.why: Invented. The three friends spend the film plotting to kill their bosses. The plot and quotes have no pizza scene, and Nick's real lines are about his awful job and Harken.
facts.fix: Hear me out, Dale. We split the big plate of wings, and nobody says the word boss tonight.

facts.text: Back booth, where MF Jones does business.

vibe.verdict: The bar tab layout is a good fit and the murder consultant gag lands, but the best set pieces are missing.
